ios.desc:
Calculate with confidence. BVCalc Lite combines live-updating algebraic entry with an RPN stack that shows the full expression behind every value. Reuse past work with a tap, switch modes anytime, and audit every step.

Upgrade to BVCalc to unlock
• Unlimited history tape & memory (Lite supports up to 2 items in memory and 4 calculations in the history tape)
• Additional color theme & settings
• No helper popups on scientific keys
• Full external-keyboard letter shortcuts

Core features in Lite
• Live result as you type — no “=” key
• Reuse expressions from the tape/stack, not just values
• Shared tape/stack with readable infix history
• Switch between Algebraic ↔ RPN mid-calculation
• Touch-friendly stack gestures (tap to swap/roll)
• Basic & Scientific keyboards; copy/paste; edit history
• Color-coded parentheses, themes, high-contrast mode
• Memory for reusable snippets
• No ads

BVCalc Lite makes partial-step workflows fast and reliable: what you see is the math you actually entered.

quotes.text:
Working on adding features to my app.
I wrote BVCalc because I wanted a calculator that would show not only the numerical result value but also show the corresponding algebraic expression that I entered so that I could check for entry mistakes and more easily keep track of calculations. I also wanted this feature to work even when the calculator is in RPN mode. That is, I wanted to be able to use RPN entry, and have the calculator show both the result value and the corresponding algebraic expression (displayed using infix notation, not RPN) for each item on the stack.

I was surprised that such a feature was not available on any existing calculators and so I wrote my own. Runs on macOS, iPhone, and iPad.

BVCalc Lite (free version, no ads):
https://apps.apple.com/app/bvcalc-lite/id6544784034

BVCalc (paid version):
https://apps.apple.com/app/bvcalc/id6560108221
